profile.reading: Per Digital Realty own site, this Los Angeles facility (LAX10) sits at 600 West 7th Street and totals 489,500 square feet across 7 stories, with N+1 power and cooling redundancy and access to over 25 network providers. The building is seismically rated for the Los Angeles region and is recognized as an LA Green Business for energy efficiency. The facility is SOC2, SOC3, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001 certified. No power capacity in MW is published on this page.
